desc:
💰 Welcome to Bid For Brainrot!

Join crazy auction duels, bid your cash, and collect the rarest Brainrots!

✅ How to Play:

🏦 Join an auction table
💰 Bid against another player
🧟 Win Brainrots and add them to your collection
📈 Earn money from your Brainrots
🍀 Upgrade your luck to roll rarer Brainrots
🔄 Rebirth to become stronger
🎁 Gift passes to your friends

Can you outbid everyone and build the best Brainrot collection?

Leave a like and join our group to support the game and get free reward! ❤️
